details.type: RingClock stores borrowed cookie,uint64 now_us callback and optional int idle callback. now_us has no availability/error return channel;zero is a time sample,not failed/successful hardware status. Service ring_now wraps KernelTime with null cookie/local output,stack clock has null idle. Published copies supplied struct to static g.clock but cookie remains borrowed;actual K80 producer/epoch/idle semantics not bound.
details.ring: Wait/observe initialize observed,refuse unattached/poisoned and invalid fence. Each loop acquires fence cache then checks fence value before missing-clock/deadline/idle checks. Thus timeout0 or null clock can still inspect current fence;missing clock only times out if pending. Cache failure or value beyond issued domain poisons;observe does not advance completed_ while wait sets it on passing fence. No API0 as stop/DMA lease.
details.deadline: Start and subsequent now samples are microseconds;timeout_us is uint32 and subtraction unsigned64. If pending,elapsed>=timeout returns timeout;nonzero idle result also folds to fence timeout,raw callback int not exposed here. Backward/nonadvancing clock behavior and callback nonreturning latency are not bounded by this code. Finite timeout parameter alone is not hardware monotonic guarantee or bounded native execution;no successful constant-clock/fence model or retry policy invented.
details.submit: Submit observe maps ring poison/argument/timeout to existing IOReturn domains. Submit wait selects active Job ring or historical lookup,then on timeout counts/notifies noteStall and returns Timeout;passed active job may release refs. waitAll loops outstanding jobs and supplies same timeout anew to each wait,so it is not one total wall deadline or preempt-flight/DMA stop proof. Previous history/wrap/active28th guard gaps remain independent.
details.borrow: Ring wait invokes callbacks synchronously and does not store clock pointer in this body. Submit timeout noteStall and caller-owned clock functions may add work;actual provider/latency/serialization must be source-bound. Do not infer optional idle callback0 equals IRQ arrival/retirement or that elapsed VM hook controls these loops.
